slides.title: Resume ke boring bullets ko *impact* mein badlo
slides.subtitle: Ek copy-paste prompt. Kisi bhi AI chatbot ke saath chalega.

slides.title: Recruiter ko *duties* nahi, *results* chahiye
slides.body: Most resume bullets only list tasks. A strong bullet shows what you did, how you did it, and what changed because of it.

slides.title: Fark dekho
slides.before: Responsible for managing the college fest social media.
slides.after: Planned and posted daily Instagram content for our college fest, and coordinated a 5-member volunteer team.
slides.why: Action verb + what you did + scope. Use only real details from your own work.

slides.title: Ye prompt *copy* karo
slides.prompt:
Act as a resume coach. Rewrite this bullet so it starts with a strong action verb, says what I did and how, and mentions the result.

Bullet: [paste your bullet]
Role I'm applying for: [job title]

Do not invent numbers. If a number would help, ask me for it.
slides.note: Last line important hai: AI ko fake numbers banane se roko.

slides.title: Kaam ka laga?
slides.text: Roz ek naya prompt. Interview, resume, study, sab ke liye.
